summary:
Review 12 of w245, commit fa1b6eea (the one the implementer's result lists). It fixes review 10's findings as ruled: a failure is a scenario only when work_items names it (pytest-bdd __scenario__, SCENARIO lines); -n 0 is added only where the command had -n; errors are read from the short summary and the last line; ruff is clean.
No test removed or weakened; the setup/interim allowance on test_supervise_merge_rerun.py holds. Nothing changed under features/.
Checks: ruff, vulture clean; size: nothing over 300. Touched test modules: 21 passed. The merge's suite record shows r222 taking a scenario of another concern back (log.jsonl:125).
One Minor observation: has_error reads from the first 'short test summary info' in the output, so a nested pytest summary in captured output can refuse a merge (errs towards refusing); fix: rpartition.
